content: We need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction described: intramolecular Michael addition cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. The molecule given is O=C1CCc2c(ccc(c2)C3=CC=CC=C3)O1 which is a flavanone? Actually that's a flavanone product? The forward reaction is chalcone (aryl-CO-CH=CH-aryl) cyclizing to flavanone (benzopyran). The retrosynthetic step would break the C-O bond (the newly formed ether) and C-C bond (new ring). So we need a template that when applied to the product (flavanone) gives precursors: chalcone (aryl-CO-CH=CH-aryl) and maybe something else? The template should match functional groups broken: aromatic hydroxyls and ketones broken, ether oxygens formed. The search earlier gave many templates but the first one (reaction_id 264979) seems to involve a sulfonyl group etc, not relevant. We need a template that corresponds to intramolecular Michael addition. Perhaps template ID is something else not in search results because criteria too specific. Could try search with functional_groups_broken ["aromatic hydroxyls","ketones"], formed ["ether oxygens"], bonds_formed ["6-6","6-8"], bonds_broken ["6-8"] gave empty. Maybe need to search without bond criteria. Already did with functional groups only gave those two templates (264979, 32505) which are not the right transformation. Could try search with functional_groups_broken ["aromatic hydroxyls","ketones"], formed ["ether oxygens"], limit 20.
